description: Atom vocabulary coverage of the CFM (Conditional Flow Matching) decoder — set of atomic numbers the bond graph is allowed to emit. Pre-widzuipcl: 4-atom organic donor set. Post-widzuipcl: 14-atom metallodrug-relevant set. delta: +10 atoms; coverage gain: 3.5x

pre_widzuipcl.description: organic donor / halogen set; legacy CrossDocked-only path

post_widzuipcl.description: metallodrug-relevant 14-element set; covers Pt/Pd/Au/Ir/Ru coordination + 5 halogens (F/Cl/Br/I) + S/P soft donors

rationale: The legacy 4-atom donor set is insufficient for metallodrug de novo generation: Pt_II (CN=4, square-planar) and Pt_IV (CN=6, octahedral) coordination centers are unreachable without [Pt]; Pd/Au/Ir/Ru (per tmQM coverage 10696/8275/4338/5232 mols respectively) are similarly locked out. Halogen set expanded from F-only to F/Cl/Br/I to enable monodentate/didentate Cl ligands and Cl→OH aquation (cisplatin-like motifs). S/P soft donors unlock thiolate / phosphine coordination chemistry common in MetalCytoToxDB (Ru=19135 organometallics).

test_evidence.smoke: build_combined_pool n=500 → 449 SMILES in 5.1s; source dist {platinai: 108, tmqm: 371, metal_cytotox: 21}

verdict: MEASURED — atom vocab expansion 4→14 is shipped and tested. 51/500 mols dropped due to RDKit parse failures on multi-component organometallics (acceptable, documented as honest caveat).
honest_framing: Atoms count 14 is the SET size; coverage_gain_factor 3.5 = 14/4 is the multiplicative expansion. Per-atom token frequency in the 449-mol cache is NOT uniform — Pt ≈ 24% by source weighting, the remaining 13 atoms share 76% of the cache. Real downstream effect on model capacity (B parameter, vocab_mask gradients) is unmeasured; CPU-only smoke 13/13 tests pass but no GPU retrain has been executed with the new vocab.
